function.name: get_brags
function.description: Fetch specific brag entries by id. Use for brags cited by id in the fit analysis (format `[#<id> - ...]`); use search_brags for exploratory retrieval. Skip if the fit cites no brag ids.

ids.description: Brag ids to fetch. At most 8 per call.

function.name: search_brags
function.description: Full-text search the candidate's brag entries (accomplishments). Returns the top matches in BM25 order. Call once per section (experience / project / activity) and again with different queries when the first results miss a role-signals bullet.

query.description: Space-separated keywords. Use terms from the JD, role_signals, or the base résumé — not full sentences.

category.description: Restrict to one section: experience, project, or activity. Omit to search all.

function.name: search_resumes
function.description: Full-text search the candidate's past résumés for phrasing you can reuse. Only helpful when the base résumé + brags leave a role-signals bullet uncovered.
